commandContract.intentFingerprint: sha256(reviewedUser + rating + normalized content + canonical revisions)

mandatoryInvariants: authenticated review commands require a stable UUID clientRequestId
the same clientRequestId and subject always derive the same idempotency key
payload drift under the same idempotency key is a conflict
one actor may create at most one review for the configured scope and completed order
a second request identity for the same uniqueness subject cannot create a second review
lost-response retry returns the same review identity and outcome
only canonical server snapshots can establish eligibility
actor identity comes from authenticated server context and matches the order client
the reviewed user is the exact professional on the order
order completion, payment release and dispute gate are validated together
order, payment and dispute revisions are optimistic-concurrency preconditions
missing or stale canonical data fails closed
new reviews begin pending moderation and are not publicly visible
the browser cannot select publication status
review command payload rejects credentials, payment data and raw personal-data fields
command acceptance alone grants no moderation or reputation authority
localStorage, cache and local mock state never establish review authority
